description: geoportal.rlp.de: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.rlp.de. Coverage: the area served by geoportal.rlp.de. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Verkehr und Mobilität in Trier - E-Ladestation Auto (öffentlich) Trier; oeffentliche Energiethemen SGD Nord - Wasserkraftanlagen RLP - OGC API; oeffentliche Energiethemen SGD Nord - Windenergieanlagen oeffentlich S; ROK komplett - Wasserkraftanlagen RLP - OGC WFS Interface. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
